questions.question: What command did Saul fail to fully obey concerning the Amalekites?
options: To drive them beyond the Jordan
To carry off only their silver
To make a treaty with their king

questions.question: What did Samuel say God desires more than sacrifice?
Because Saul rejected God's word, God rejected him as king.
Behold, _____ is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
Saul spared King _____ and the best of the livestock, disobeying God.
